replies.body:
Hello Yahi,

If you can fix the link to the evidence, we can take your report about Zegita "Trolling In TeamSpeak" into consideration. As of now it shows the video has been removed. 

Regarding the part when he took flight, right before that, he had lagged and it could very well be a possibility that that's what contributed to that. I will keep this open for now. Please reply with your evidence in a week regarding the "TeamSpeak Trolling" or this report will be disregarded. 

Thanks.
-PokerFace
